steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In February 2024, a guest on Equity Mates described Nittetsu Mining as a mining and real estate business, operating a copper mine in Chile and starting construction on another, showing it produced copper while developing new capacity.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Adam Keily with Julian McCormack

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In February 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said Nittetsu Mining likely accessed very low interest rate debt at the corporate level in Japan, calling it a meaningful advantage versus other copper producers.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Adam Keily with Julian McCormack

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In February 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said Nittetsu Mining was doubling production at its Atacama copper asset and had a second Chile project beginning to be built, with the expansion fully funded.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Adam Keily with Julian McCormack

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In February 2024, a guest on Equity Mates argued Nittetsu Mining looked extremely cheap, noting large cash, cross shareholdings and unimproved land on the balance sheet meant the operating business was effectively free, with about half its market cap in cash.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Adam Keily with Julian McCormack
